title: Error
description: What a failing command prints on stderr with `--json`. The exit code is 1 for most errors, 2 for `usage`, 3 for `not_found` and 4 for `ambiguous`.

code.description: Stable. One of `not_found`, `ambiguous`, `invalid`, `exists`, `conflict`, `config`, `index`, `io`, `app_unavailable`, `service_unavailable`, `usage`; new codes may appear.

message.description: For people, in English; do not parse.

candidates.description: Only for `ambiguous`: the notes the reference could mean.
